description:
Configure the 'System and Server Status' module in Webmin to automatically monitor the MariaDB database server. 

1. Enable Scheduled Monitoring and set the interval to 5 minutes.
2. Create a new monitor for 'MySQL Database Server'.
3. Configure the monitor to run the command `systemctl restart mariadb` if the service goes down.
4. Set the monitor description to 'MariaDB Watchdog'.

You can access the module under Webmin > Tools > System and Server Status.
